name: OpenTyphoon
description: SCB 10X's Thai-tuned open models, free as a research showcase.
overview: OpenTyphoon is the Thai-tuned open-model family from SCB 10X, the venture arm of Siam Commercial Bank. Its FAQ calls the API a research showcase that is free to use: typhoon-v2.5-30b-a3b-instruct (a Thai fine-tune of Qwen3-30B-A3B) allows 5 requests/second and 200 requests/minute per account per model, and higher limits are available by email. Usage data is collected to improve the model and API, and production traffic is directed to Together AI.

privacy.label: Usage data used to improve the model

free_access: Free to use as a research showcase
notes: Trains on what you send; Thai-language focus. OCR and speech routes are excluded from this catalogue.
